digest.component_or_area: completion verifier gate and repo snapshot pinning
propositions: The completion verifier pins the ticket store without fetching from origin, causing show_ticket to read a stale local mirror arbitrarily many commits behind the live store, while the model context receives fresh data from the live store, creating disagreement between the two halves of the gate.

A non-PASS verdict with empty findings is coerced to FAIL and synthesizes a placeholder criterion (unspecified) instead of reporting a genuine verifier fault, making it indistinguishable from parse failure and leaving no actionable remediation path.

The close path calls materialize_tickets with fetch=False justified only for CODE refs, but this flag is threaded into TICKET store resolution where it skips origin/tickets and pins the stale local mirror in a separate repository that only advances on explicit fetch.

Two independent blocked closes were diagnosed: one with three false unmet criteria citing status open and zero comments (contradicting the live store), and a second where adding evidence anchors made the failure worse because the stale pin held zero of thirteen comment events.
